newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni final offer price seen at 9,288 lire.
newsitem.headline: Eni final offer price seen at 9,288 lire.

text.p: The final price for the public share offer (OPV) of a third tranche of state-controlled energy group Eni is likely to be 9,288 lire per share, according to analysts' calculations.

According to Eni's privatisation prospectus the final offer price will be the lower of either the official price of the last session of the OPV period less a discount of three percent or the maximum price of 9,325 lire announced last week.
The official price is the average price of the whole day's trading. Friday's official price for Eni is 9,575 lire.
The Treasury will announce the final offer price on Saturday. It is offering a minimum of 12.5 percent of Eni, with the option to extend that to 14.4 percent if demand is high.
